data_section_full_text:
We estimate these models using two distinct, but related, samples.
The ICMW sample initially includes 868 observations of firms with
December fiscal year ends from 2004 through 2007 that report ICMWs in
their SOX Section 404 reports from the Audit Analytics database. We use
the ICMW sample for testing both (1) and (2). We consider remediation
of ICMWs, which necessitates the availability of the subsequent year’s
audit report. As such, the ICMW sample only includes firms disclosing
an ICMW in 2004, 2005, and 2006, thereby reducing our sample to 768
observations. We next remove observations without necessary financial
information from COMPUSTAT and governance information from proxy
statements. These sample selection procedures yield our final ICMW sample of 733 firm-year observations. Of these, 431 firms remediate ICMWs
one year after the initial ICMW disclosure, 56 remediate two years after
the initial ICMW disclosure, and 24 remediate three years after the initial
ICMW disclosure.

We derive the control sample for testing (1) from the Audit Analytics
database. It initially includes 13,800 firms that received unqualified SOX 404
reports and that have December fiscal year ends from 2004 through 2007.
We also identify director, audit committee, CEO, and CFO turnover in the
subsequent year using the Audit Analytics database. Next, we restrict the
sample to those firms covered in the Risk Metrics database in order to gather
data for governance control variables, which reduces the sample to 3,723
firms. Finally, we remove 121 firms with missing COMPUSTAT and Center
for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) data. These sample selection procedures yield our final control sample of 3,602 firm-year observations that do
not have an ICMW. Model (1) is estimated using this control sample, plus
733 firm-year observations that do have an ICMW (as described above).
